fr.elements: Main Residence; Vehicle Parking Area; Vehicle Parking Area; Access Drive; Open Green Space; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Multiple Access Points; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from both directions of approach.
• Identify and mark a designated turnaround point on the property for emergency vehicles, such as painting curb markings or installing ground-level reflectors.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach the main residence and detached structure without obstruction.
• Mark or sign the route between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can locate both buildings quickly.
• Keep gates at all access points unlocked or equipped with a standardized emergency lock to allow rapid entry from multiple points.
• Use the open green space as a designated staging area for emergency vehicles and communicate this to responding crews by posting visible signage or markers at the property entrance.
